title: Add Anthropic tool-schema prompt caching (Option B: separate switch)
description: Extend providers/caching.ts to cache tool schemas independently of system-prompt caching. Per-agent env: <AGENT>_TOOL_CACHING=true. When enabled and model supports prompt-caching, attach providerOptions.anthropic.cacheControl to the last tool in the agent's tool map — Anthropic uses cache breakpoints (max 4/request). Documented surface per chunk-3RIGZMZ5.js:14612-14631. Option B chosen over combined switch because tools have lower cache breakeven (1-2 reuses) than system prompts (5+).
close_reason: Delivered: providers/caching.ts extended with AGENT_TOOL_CACHING + toolsWithCacheControl helper that attaches providerOptions.anthropic.cacheControl to the last tool in each agent's tool map (one breakpoint covers the whole schema block; Anthropic caps at 4/request). Wired into foreman/discovery/execution/history; supervisor uses agents:, not tools:, so SUPERVISOR_TOOL_CACHING is an accepted no-op. AGENT_REQUIREMENTS dynamically adds prompt-caching capability when either prompt-caching switch is on, so startup validation fails fast regardless of which switch. 8 new tests; 231 total. Commit caecd4f.

title: Add per-provider cost tracking
description: Hand-curated pricing table per model (input/output per 1M tokens). Hook into Mastra generation lifecycle to log {agent, model, provider, in_tokens, out_tokens, in_cost, out_cost, total_cost} per call. Always-on log line; OTEL metric gated on OTEL_ENABLED. Pricing table lives alongside capabilities registry.
close_reason: Delivered: providers/cost.ts with hand-curated MODEL_PRICING table (Anthropic/OpenAI/Google, per 1M tokens including Anthropic cached-input rates), calculateCost() returning a CostBreakdown with provider-attributed USD costs, and onFinishCostLogger() returning a StreamTextOnFinishCallback (documented Mastra type ai-sdk-v5 index.d.ts:8329). Wired into each agent's defaultOptions.onFinish so every generation emits a structured JSON log line. OTEL counter foreman.llm.cost.usd emitted when OTEL_ENABLED=true, matching existing Observability gate in mastra/index.ts. 7 new unit tests; 223 total passing. Commit 0f9661c.

title: Add Anthropic prompt caching via capability registry
description: Add 'prompt-caching' capability to MODEL_CAPABILITIES. Agents opt in via a per-agent flag; when the configured model supports caching, wrap system prompt in providerOptions.anthropic.cacheControl: { type: 'ephemeral' }. Scope: system prompt only for v1 (tool schemas deferred). Fail-closed on non-Anthropic models (providerOptions simply not attached).
close_reason: Delivered: providers/caching.ts with per-agent env opt-in (<AGENT>_PROMPT_CACHING). When enabled, agent system prompt is wrapped as SystemModelMessage with providerOptions.anthropic.cacheControl (documented AI SDK pattern, ai/docs/02-foundations/03-prompts.mdx:118-133). Added 'prompt-caching' capability to MODEL_CAPABILITIES (Anthropic-only). AGENT_REQUIREMENTS composes dynamically so enabling caching on a non-supporting model fails startup. 7 new tests; 216 pass. Commit 77813f3.

title: Add per-agent model params (temperature, maxTokens, topP)

title: Add flexible per-agent model provider config
description:
Extract hardcoded MODELS constant into src/lib/providers/ module so each agent's model is driven from env. Introduces MODEL_DEFAULT/FAST/HEAVY tier defaults and per-agent overrides (FOREMAN_MODEL, DISCOVERY_MODEL, EXECUTION_MODEL, SUPERVISOR_MODEL, HISTORY_MODEL). Per-agent vars accept comma-separated fallback chains mapped to Mastra's ModelWithRetries[] shape.

Capability registry (providers/capabilities.ts) tracks tools + streaming across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google models. validateAgentCapabilities() runs at Mastra boot and fails fast on unknown models, typos, or missing capabilities.

All existing behavior preserved when no env vars set. 200 tests pass, 11 new tests in providers.test.ts. Implemented on branch claude/add-multiple-providers-wXhQJ, commit f017d55.
close_reason: Provider flexibility delivered: central providers module with per-agent env overrides (FOREMAN_MODEL, DISCOVERY_MODEL, EXECUTION_MODEL, SUPERVISOR_MODEL, HISTORY_MODEL) + tier defaults (MODEL_DEFAULT/FAST/HEAVY), comma-separated fallback chains mapped to Mastra ModelWithRetries[], capability registry (tools + streaming across Anthropic/OpenAI/Google), startup validation that fails fast on unknown models. 15 new unit + integration tests pass (11 provider resolution/validation + 4 AIMock routing). 204 tests total, zero regressions. Commits f017d55, ced8818 on branch claude/add-multiple-providers-wXhQJ.

title: Add per-agent voice provider selection across all Mastra voice providers
description: Foreman currently hardcodes OpenAI Whisper for STT and ElevenLabs (with OpenAI fallback) for TTS. Extend providers/ to make voice provider-agnostic using Mastra's @mastra/voice-* packages. Document research of what Mastra actually supports (likely openai, elevenlabs, google, azure, deepgram, playht, murf, sarvam, cloudflare, speechify) and wire via env var pattern. Design to be reviewed before coding.

title: Re-enable OpenAI end-to-end test after AIMock annotations drift fix
description: AIMock v1.14.3's OpenAI Responses API emitter omits the annotations: [] field on output_text content parts, which @ai-sdk/openai's Zod schema now requires. AIMock classifies this as warning-level drift (not critical) so their auto-fix pipeline has not shipped a fix yet. There is no documented hook (fixture override, config flag, or middleware) inside AIMock to patch the response shape. The docs-documented fix points — wrapLanguageModel, createOpenAI({fetch}), HTTP proxy — all require patching application or test code, which is a workaround we do not want.\n\nAction items: (1) File a drift report upstream at https://github.com/CopilotKit/aimock/issues naming the annotations field and citing the drift-detection policy. (2) Track the upstream fix or the AIMock version that reclassifies this as critical. (3) When the field is emitted, re-add the openai/gpt-4o smoke test in tests/integration/provider-swap.test.ts that was removed in commit ac63ee8.

Fix fixture JSON + aimock-setup.ts base URL handling, re-run provider-swap integration test to confirm clean deserialization.
close_reason: Delivered documented-only fix: appended /v1 to ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in aimock-setup.ts (matches AIMock's official useAimock() Vitest plugin verbatim). Anthropic default path now returns clean deserializable text end-to-end. OpenAI Responses API path remains blocked by AIMock v1.14.3 omitting the required annotations: [] field — this is upstream drift with no documented in-codebase hook.
